name: Karin Karlsbro - Proposition de la Commission
title: Establishing the Ukraine Loan Cooperation Mechanism and providing exceptional macro-financial assistance to Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a plan to lend Ukraine up to 35 billion euros, as part of a larger international package worth up to 45 billion euros. Ukraine will not have to repay the money directly. Instead, the loan will be paid back using the profits earned on Russian state money that is frozen in the European Union. The money is meant to help Ukraine with its urgent needs during the war.

- The European Union would lend Ukraine up to 35 billion euros, repaid from profits on frozen Russian assets.
- It affects Ukraine, which receives the money, and the European Union, which carries the risk.
- Parliament approved the plan; the final rules still need to be agreed and the money released.
